title: Python plans pair typed checks with runtime evidence

task.prompt: Use /spec to plan a Python plugin-registry change whose handlers are loaded through decorators and **kwargs. Return the impact and verification plan without implementation.
task.fixture: isolated Python repo with pyright, pytest, testmon, decorators, and runtime plugin discovery

requirements.criterion: The design treats static Python references as a lower bound and includes runtime test/coverage selection plus a dynamic-dispatch gap statement.

Each planned behavior has an executable pytest/public-seam verification route, rather than only pyright or grep output. This ordinary inline plan creates no `.scratch/*/FEATURE.md` or other `.scratch` planning file.

Planning uses read-only references and retained runtime evidence without source mutation. A differential probe is optional planned execution work in a task-owned isolated copy, using the actual candidate and comparable baseline/candidate cwd, command and checker version; only new diagnostics are typed impact candidates, never behavior proof, and independent typecheck gates remain intact.

graders.procedure: The trace has no Write/Edit inside the worktree (reverted temporary edits included) and git status is clean at the end of planning.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';w=[p for i,p,g in W if not rel(p).startswith('..')];s=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();print(w,s);sys.exit(bool(w or s))"

graders.procedure: Read the plan. Require public-seam behavior checks and distinguish typed/structural facts, actually observed runtime evidence or its absence, and planned checks; state the dynamic-dispatch gap. Fail product or verification-tool implementation or future behavior-suite runs. Do not require a mutation probe. If one is proposed, require execution-stage isolation, the actual candidate and comparable baseline/candidate inputs, exclude pre-existing or line-shift-only diagnostics, classify new diagnostics as candidates rather than behavior proof, and preserve independent typecheck gates.
graders.why_not_automated: Whether the plan treats static references as a lower bound, states the dynamic-dispatch gap and classifies probe diagnostics correctly is a semantic reading of plan prose.
